results.name: David L. Richter Named Chief Executive Officer at BE&K Building Group
results.content:
BE&K Building Group announces a CEO transition, welcoming David L. Richter to lead the company into its next chapter of growth and continued success.
BE&K Building Group announces a CEO transition, welcoming David L. Richter to lead the company into its next chapter of growth and continued success. RALEIGH, NC, UNITED STATES, August 10, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- BE&K Building Group (BE&K), a leading design-build and construction management services company with more than 55 years of national experience delivering complex, high-performance projects, has announced that David L.
Frank Holley, who has served as the company’s CEO since 2019, has transitioned to the role of Chairman as part of a planned leadership succession. Nidal Zayed, Chairman, President, and CEO of Pernix Group (BE&K’s parent company), remarked that this transition honors the company’s growth under Frank’s leadership and sets the stage for its next chapter under David.
Left to right: Pat Chisholm, President, BE&K Building Group; Nidal Zayed, CEO, President, & Chairman of the Board, Pernix Group; David Richter, CEO, BE&K Building Group; Frank Holley, Chairman, BE&K Building Group
“As a Pernix board member for nearly five years, David’s deep understanding of BE&K’s business, his proven leadership, and his commitment to our company’s values position him well to lead the company through its next phase of growth and innovation.” Reflecting on the transition, Holley shared, “Leading this company as its CEO for the past seven years has been the privilege of my career, and I am immensely proud of what we have accomplished together.

results.name: Bekaert Announces Leadership Change As Olivier Biebuyck Takes Over As CEO
results.content:
Bekaert’s Board of Directors has announced the appointment of Olivier Biebuyck as the company’s next Chief Executive Officer, effective 1 June 2026. He
Bekaert’s Board of Directors has announced the appointment of Olivier Biebuyck as the company’s next Chief Executive Officer, effective 1 June 2026. He brings extensive expertise in leading, expanding and transforming global industrial enterprises through both organic growth and acquisitions, positioning him to drive Bekaert’s future strategic goals. On that same date, the board will co-opt Biebuyck as a director. Meanwhile, current CEO and board member Yves Kerstens will conclude his mandate on 31 May 2026, having led the company in recent years.
Elkem ASA, a global leader in advanced silicon-based materials, has announced the appointment of Dag Teigland as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective 3 August 2026. The board’s decision coincides with the departure of Helge Aasen, who will step down after leading the company since 2009 to take on the role of Chairman of the Board. Bringing more than two decades of industrial and investment expertise, Teigland currently serves as executive chairman of Tekna Holding ASA, a firm known for advanced metal powders.
The leadership transition marks a carefully planned succession, with Biebuyck’s track record seen as critical to advancing Bekaert’s long-term ambitions. The changes take effect at the end of May and start of June 2026. Jürgen Tinggren, Chairman of the Board of Directors, said, “I am proud to announce the appointment of Olivier Biebuyck as CEO of Bekaert.

#### **Veena Khan Appointed New CEO and Executive Director of LIC International**  
- **LIC International**has appointed**Veena Khan as its new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Executive Director.**
- LIC International is a Bahrain-based subsidiary of the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), providing insurance services primarily across the GCC region.
- Veena Khan succeeds Debashis Prasad Pattanaik, who retired as CEO and Executive Director in July 2026.
#### **10 August – International Biodiesel Day**  
- **International Biodiesel Day**is observed annually on**10 August**to promote awareness about biodiesel as a renewable and alternative fuel.
- The day commemorates Rudolf Diesel, who demonstrated the use of peanut oil as fuel in his engine in 1893.
- Biodiesel is a cleaner, biodegradable fuel that can help reduce dependence on conventional fossil fuels and greenhouse-gas emissions.
